title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above and in front. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square. An orange raised disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts give moves made and steps still needed to reach the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes the row or the column by one. The fewest moves is the rows apart plus the columns apart: 2 + 2 = 4.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Start and goal are always the same squares; Reset returns the token to the same start. The board has no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
